//: Everything Claude runs (Claude tab). Server-only: claudeWork sends it to admins; koyOnly rows go to Koy alone. Edit this file to update the list (see scripts/claude-inventory-test.js for the shape). pulled:false shows the 'Not pulled yet' tag: nothing in the app or a Claude routine reads or refreshes it yet.

groups.label: Automations
groups.sub: Claude routines on a schedule · Denver time

groups.label: App and dashboard features
groups.sub: parts of Command Center Claude fills in or works

groups.label: Sheets and docs

items.title: Morning brief
items.what: Posts one short read of the day: today's meetings, threads that went quiet, calendar clashes and the top 5 Command Center items.
items.from: Google Calendar, Gmail, Google Chat and Command Center.

items.title: Check-ins (Heartbeat)
items.when: Every 3 hours, about 5 AM to 8 PM, every day
items.what: Looks back and ahead 3 hours and posts only when something needs Koy. Quiet runs post nothing.
items.from: Calendar, mail, chat, texts and the open tasks.

items.title: Meeting prep
items.what: Finds today's meeting docs, adds Claude's updates to them, and lists jobs that still need a date.
items.from: Google Calendar and the meeting docs in Drive.

items.title: Email digest
items.what: Lists the emails that need Koy. Read only: it never sends or files anything.
items.from: Koy's Gmail.

items.title: CC and Simpro sync check
items.what: Finds newly scheduled Simpro jobs missing from Command Center, return trips missing material or POs, and CED orders ready for pickup. Each one becomes a Needs you flag.
items.from: Simpro and Command Center.
items.note: Stops Dec 31 unless Koy keeps it.

items.title: Job card ready check
items.what: Any rough-in or finish starting in the next 7 days with an unfinished job card becomes a Needs you flag.
items.from: Simpro schedule and Command Center job cards.

items.title: Margin watch
items.what: Lists jobs at 25% total margin or lower and works out whether each can still reach 15%. Files a report to the Reports list.
items.from: Simpro job totals (whole job).

items.title: Plan revision check
items.what: Tells Koy which FieldInk plans got a new version since the last weekday.
items.from: FieldInk plans.

items.title: CED pickups
items.what: Ticks Picked up on CED PO cards in Command Center once CED shows them picked up. Koy said yes to this one ahead of time.
items.from: CED pickup emails and Command Center material cards.

items.title: Post-rough-in report
items.what: Once a job's rough-in is 100% invoiced, writes how the rough went and files it to the Reports list.
items.from: Simpro invoices and job costs, Command Center.

items.title: Finish plans and foreman packets
items.what: Writes a finish plan when Base Rough In is 100% invoiced, and a foreman packet when a phase gets scheduled. Refreshes them when the job changes. Filed to Reports.
items.from: Simpro, Command Center and the job's plans.

items.title: Job issues watch
items.what: Finds change orders missing from Command Center (signed ones are added on their own), quotes not converted and failed inspections. The 4:13 run posts a decision list; Thursdays it builds the gaps doc.
items.from: Simpro quotes and jobs, Command Center, inspection emails.
items.note: Stops Dec 31 unless Koy keeps it.

items.title: Crew schedule watch
items.when: Weekdays 7:13 AM, 10:13 AM, 1:13 PM, 4:13 PM, 8:13 PM
items.what: Catches scheduling asks, slipped jobs, phase starts with no PO, the Simpro inbox, time off and meeting action items. Puts suggested blocks on the crew calendar and preps Thursday strategy.
items.from: Google Chat, texts, email, Simpro and the crew calendar.
items.note: Stops Dec 31 unless Koy keeps it.

items.title: Command Center dashboard check
items.what: Checks the dashboard's numbers look right and that the last Vercel deploy had no errors.
items.from: The dashboard and Vercel.

items.title: Asks watch
items.when: Weekdays 6:41 AM, 9:41 AM, 12:41 PM, 3:41 PM, 6:41 PM
items.what: Collects asks people make of Koy and, on his yes, adds the ones that need him to My Day.
items.from: Email, Google Chat, texts and My Day.

items.title: Granola next steps
items.what: Finds next steps from today's meetings that haven't landed anywhere yet.
items.from: Granola meeting notes.
items.note: Stops Dec 31 unless Koy keeps it.

items.title: Plan Intake: file emailed plans
items.when: Every day 7 AM, noon, 4 PM, 9 PM
items.what: Files plans that come in by email into the right job's Drive folder and matches redline walks to jobs. Anything it can't place waits under Plan Intake.
items.from: Gmail attachments and the Job Plans folders in Drive.

items.title: Plan Intake weekly review
items.what: A read-only report on the last 30 days of plan filing: what went where and what it missed.
items.from: Plan Intake's own results.

items.title: CO chase list
items.what: Lists change orders waiting on the GC 7 days or more and old open questions, and drafts follow-up emails in Gmail. It never sends them.
items.from: Command Center change orders and questions, Gmail.

items.title: Tuesday office meeting doc
items.what: Builds the Tuesday Office Meeting doc in the Meeting Prep folder.
items.from: Command Center, Simpro and last week's doc.

items.title: Monday office meeting prefill (old)
items.what: The old office meeting prefill. It still runs and overlaps the Tuesday office meeting doc.
items.from: Command Center and the old meeting doc.
items.note: Overlaps the Tuesday doc. Can likely be turned off.

items.title: Foreman meeting pull
items.what: Rebuilds the "Wednesday Foreman Meeting: Template Options" Claude Doc for the next morning.
items.from: Job Costs (foreman view), Command Center.

items.title: Forecast vs actual review
items.what: When a job closes, compares the margin forecast to how it really finished.
items.from: Simpro final job totals and past margin watch reports.

items.title: Appliance Loads nightly refresh
items.what: Pulls appliance specs from job and quote folders into Appliance Loads - Master and checks them against Command Center Home Runs. Mondays it also checks wire sizes.
items.from: Job and quote folders in Drive, Command Center Home Runs.

items.title: Refresh command deck
items.what: Updates the Koy Command Deck page with the newest build number and ship log.
items.from: The app's repo.
items.note: Runs only while Koy's Mac is on.

items.title: Homestead skill refresh
items.what: Weekly check that Claude's quick notes on the app still match the app.
items.from: The app's repo and the vault notes.
items.note: Runs only while Koy's Mac is on.

items.title: Downloads and Desktop tidy-up
items.what: Sorts loose files on the Mac's Desktop and Downloads into folders.
items.from: Koy's Mac.
items.note: Runs only while Koy's Mac is on.

items.title: Scheduling helper
items.what: Old scheduling helper. Its channel is archived; the crew schedule watch does this now.

items.title: Bukhshtaber sconce watch
items.what: Watched for one job's sconces. Done.

items.title: Crew week board refresh
items.what: Refreshed the crew week whiteboard. The crew calendar in Command Center replaced it.

items.title: Automations list sync
items.what: Kept the Automations list current. Turned off Nov 13; each routine checks in on its own now.

items.title: Old main-chat morning brief
items.what: The first morning brief. The morning-brief one replaced it.

items.title: CC snapshot (Dashboard tab)
items.what: Took a daily snapshot of Command Center for the dashboard. The dashboard reads live now.

items.title: Friday strategy meeting prefill
items.what: Prefilled the Friday strategy meeting. The Meetings tab does this now.

items.title: Sync homestead brain (Obsidian)
items.what: Synced the app's notes into Koy's Obsidian vault.

items.title: Refresh Claude creations shelf
items.what: Kept a shelf page of what Claude made. This page replaces it.

items.title: Refresh app updates training
items.what: Refreshed the app updates training page.

items.title: 90-Day Friday review
items.what: Friday check of Koy's first 90 days plan.

items.title: 90-Day Monday plan
items.what: Monday plan from Koy's first 90 days plan.

items.title: Etsy weekly stats read (2)
items.what: Read the Etsy shop's weekly stats. Two copies, both off.

items.title: App Map suggestions watcher
items.what: Watched for App Map suggestions.

items.title: Needs you list
items.what: One flag per job for anything that needs Koy: missing POs, open punch, missing info, scheduling asks. Answer it right there with Yes, Schedule it, Add to my tasks, Done or Dismiss.
items.from: The sync check, job issues, crew schedule, asks and Granola watches and the job card check.

items.title: Automations list
items.what: Every Claude routine with when it runs, what it does on its own and how its last run went.
items.from: Each routine checks in at the end of its run.

items.title: Reports list
items.what: Every report Claude files: post-rough-in, margin watch, finish plans and foreman packets, by job then type. Dollar reports show to admins only.
items.from: The report routines, filed through the Homestead connector.

items.title: My Day asks
items.what: Asks people make of Koy that need something from him, added on his yes. Not FYIs.
items.from: The asks watch.

items.title: Crew calendar suggestions
items.what: Suggested blocks (dotted green) and proposed scheduling rules. Koy said these need no ask. A suggestion never books Simpro.
items.from: The crew schedule watch, Simpro and the Crew Board.

items.title: Material cards
items.what: Puts the sent Simpro PO number on a material card and ticks it Ordered, and ticks CED orders Picked up. Both are standing yeses.
items.from: Simpro POs and CED pickup emails.

items.title: Change orders
items.what: Adds signed change orders from Simpro as approved so none get missed.
items.from: The job issues watch reading Simpro quotes.

items.title: Plan intake queue
items.what: Emailed plans the intake routine couldn't file on its own wait here for Koy to File it or mark Not ours.
items.from: Plan Intake runs.

items.title: Meetings tab items
items.what: Adds one item at a time to the Lead, Foreman or Friday Strategy meeting on Koy's yes, marked Added by Claude.
items.from: Koy's ask in chat.

items.title: FieldInk Claude Duet layers
items.what: Markup and keypads Claude draws go on their own Claude Duet layers above Koy's, so he can keep, hide or delete them.
items.from: The plan and Koy's ask.

items.title: Claude Scheduling Write Log
items.what: Audit log of Claude's scheduling writes. The Log tab has one row per write: when, app, job, who, work date, what changed and Koy's OK. The Watch tab has one row per text or chat message Claude checked: who sent it, the job, what it said, what Claude did and why.
items.from: Claude's scheduling writes and message checks. Still being written (last edited Nov 26).
items.note: The Changes and What I checked lists on this tab show the same things.

items.title: Appliance Loads - Master
items.what: Appliance load workbook. Each job has its own tab (job number and name) with one row per appliance: item, location, qty, voltage, amps, breaker, model and whether Home Runs has it. Master combines every job; Model Library keeps specs by model number; Run Log and Wire Check track each night's pass.
items.from: The Appliance Loads nightly refresh writes it; this tab reads its Run Log.

items.title: Simpro POs - Master
items.what: PO register. All POs has one row per PO: PO number, date, job number and name, supplier, rough or finish, cost center, status, picked up and which material list it landed on. Summary counts by job and status; Needs a look lists POs to fix, like a job number that matches no open job.
items.from: The app's own Simpro PO pull writes it every hour. Not a Claude routine.
items.note: The app rewrites it every hour, so hand edits don't stay.

items.title: One-on-One Tracker (old sheet)
items.what: Koy's first one-on-one tracker. A Guide tab with the 20-minute, six-step format, a Dashboard roll-up, and one tab per crew member with last and next due dates, a meetings log and an items list.
items.from: Nothing updates it now.
items.note: Replaced by the Residential One-on-Ones page.

items.title: Copy of Team Goals 2026-2027
items.what: Koy's copy of the team goals. One Goals tab with the overall goal, then tables by time period (Area, Goal, Who, By, Status).
items.from: Koy keeps it; the Goals tab puts today's numbers beside it.

items.title: Foreman + Lead Meeting Weekly Notes
items.what: Running weekly agenda for the Foreman + Lead meeting, newest week at the top: Notes, Highlight, Lowlight, Carried from last week and Needs.
items.from: The app's foreman meeting prep writes the new week in.

items.title: Notes - Weekly Lead Meeting
items.what: Weekly lead meeting notes, one dated section per meeting: a Schedule of crew by job for each day, then Upcoming jobs with their start dates.
items.from: Koy writes it; the meeting prep runs read it.

items.title: Notes - Weekly Resi Foreman Meeting
items.what: Short residential foreman meeting notes, newest first: who came, Notes and Action items. Only a few October meetings are in it.
items.from: Koy writes it. Nothing in the app reads it yet; the Meetings tab's Foreman Meeting is the live version.

items.title: Work Texts
items.what: An export of Koy's work texts that the watches read.
items.from: Koy's Mac.
items.note: Only refreshes while the Mac is awake.

items.title: Docs Claude makes each week
items.what: Tuesday Office Meeting docs (Meeting Prep folder), CO and trip gaps docs (Friday Strategy folder) and the Claude Docs behind Reports (finish plans, packets, post-rough-in reports).
items.from: The routines above make them.

items.title: Koy Bonus Tracker
items.what: Josh's bonus workbook for Koy, built from Simpro job data. Jobs pulls each job's revenue, cost and invoicing; Tracker scores each job (hit target, handoff, bonus earned, payout status). Supporting tabs: Detail, Small Jobs Pool, Config, Payouts, Handoff, Log and backups.
items.from: Josh keeps it; nothing in the app reads it.

items.title: Homestead Material Forecast 2026 (CED American Fork)
items.what: Material outlook for CED American Fork: parts still to buy for sold jobs, by the month they'll be needed. Summary gives the 90-day outlook; CED Parts Forecast has one row per part with monthly quantities; the rest are inputs (won quotes, open POs, jobs, prices).
items.from: Josh keeps it. The Weekly Scramble links to it but doesn't read it.

items.title: Store Charges With No PO
items.what: Supply-store card charges with no PO, to be matched up. One tab, one row per charge: date, store, amount, cardholder, job number, notes, status and whether the receipt is in BILL.
items.from: Josh keeps it.

items.title: Interview Sheet
items.what: Hiring log, one row per candidate: interview date, contact, location, license, school, experience, tools, start date, transportation, pay expectation, rank and notes.
items.from: Josh keeps it.

items.title: Notes - Weekly Strategy/Scheduling Meeting
items.what: Owners' and office strategy and scheduling notes, one section per week, newest first back to Sept 2025: who came, then notes job by job on material, change orders and next week.
items.from: Josh writes it. The app's Friday Strategy prep reads it, read only.

items.title: Builder Scorecard
items.what: Rates each builder on how they pay and how profitable their work is, with a verdict (keep, raise price, tighten terms, collect first). Scorecard is the main view; it draws on Sales, A/R Aging, Job Margin, Days to Pay, Change Orders, Win Rate and Upcoming Work tabs.
items.from: Josh keeps it.

items.title: Weekly Scramble (notes doc)
items.what: Weekly Scramble notes, one section per week, newest first: General and Schedule, with jobs grouped by phase showing percent done, booked crew and open items.
items.from: The Meetings tab's Weekly Scramble follows its order but doesn't read the doc.
items.note: Last edited Nov 10. The Meetings tab's Weekly Scramble took over.

items.title: SOP Sending Quote Options
items.what: Office SOP for quotes with optional items: the customer gets a link to pick options and their picks come back into Simpro. Purpose, the three quote statuses, then numbered steps.
items.from: Josh keeps it.

items.title: Team Goals 2026-2027 (Josh's)
items.what: The original team goals sheet Koy's copy came from: one Goals tab with goal tables by time period.
items.from: Private to Josh, so the Goals tab reads Koy's copy instead.

items.title: Koys Responsibilities
items.what: Josh's written role description for Koy: bulleted lists under Overall Residential Management, Job Prep and Redlines and more.
items.from: Josh keeps it.

items.title: Project Managing Sheet
items.what: Older project tracking sheet. Upcoming is a sales follow-up list; one tab per foreman with a row per job (phase, status, next steps, QC, panel schedules).
items.from: Josh keeps it.

items.title: Foreman - Profit Share
items.what: Older foreman profit share sheet: the payout rule on top, then one row per job with price, invoiced, cost and profit, then the split and date paid.
items.from: Josh keeps it.

items.title: Foreman bonus trackers (Daegan, Gage, Abraham, Vasa, Colby, Keegan, MASTER)
items.what: One bonus sheet per foreman (same layout: one row per job with price, invoiced, costs, profit and date paid), plus a MASTER roll-up with one row per foreman.
items.from: Josh keeps them.
items.note: Daegan's was last edited Sep 2026; the rest and the MASTER in Jul 2026.

items.title: Notes - Foreman Meeting (older)
items.what: The older foreman meeting notes (Sept 2025 to June 2026): one section per meeting with General, P/L Review and Schedule Look Ahead, and a job status list per person. A smaller July copy also exists.

items.title: Review notes (Apr and Dec 2025 rounds)
items.what: Notes from the review rounds.

items.what: Employee Files holds one folder per employee. Service Size Calculator holds the code for a load calculator add-on to Command Center (two versions). Homestead Generator App holds a deploy guide and a handoff written for Koy.

items.title: Standards - Homestead Electric

items.title: Notes - Weekly Lead Meeting (Aug)
items.what: Brady's earlier lead meeting notes (March to August 2026): one section per meeting with Notes, Highlight, Lowlight and Training.

items.title: Sandlin Design meeting notes
items.what: Gemini's auto notes from the Sept 17 Sandlin design call (1480 Sandlin Residence). It lists who was invited and links the transcript; there's no summary in it.

items.title: Notes - Commercial Project Review
items.what: Notes from the commercial project review: mainly a numbered commercial job start process, from quote approval through setup, job numbers, cost codes and folders.

items.title: Notes - AI Coordination
items.what: Notes from the monthly AI Coordination meeting: General, Wins Review, Deep Dive Use Case, Brainstorm Round and Action items. One meeting is logged (March 2026).

items.title: Satisfaction surveys (Aug 26, 2 forms)

items.title: Homestead Electric Generator Tracker

items.title: QC System Template
items.what: The blank QC checklist copied for each job. Rough QC and Finish QC tabs: who did it and when, then rows by section with room, item, pass or fail and notes. Failed items collect on their own tabs.
items.note: Older copies of it also exist.

items.title: Foreman Responsibilities
items.what: Short outline of the foreman role: field project manager, material (PO oversight, waste, deliveries), tools, field strategy, morale, training and the schedule.
